items.prompt: Given this fraction: 3/4 Complete the space below, and then write the equivalent fraction.
items.demo: To multiply by one, top and bottom must be the same. The bottom is five, so we write *five* on top: 5/5.
Three times five is fifteen, and four times five is twenty. Three fourths is equivalent to *fifteen over twenty*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply three fourths by one.
items.demo: The bottom is five, so the top must be *five*. Five over five is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Three times five is fifteen, and four times five is twenty: *15/20*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply seven thirds by one.
items.demo: The bottom is ten, so the top must be *ten*. Ten over ten is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Seven times ten is seventy, and three times ten is thirty: *70/30*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply two fifths by one.
items.demo: The bottom is three, so the top must be *three*. Three over three is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Two times three is six, and five times three is fifteen: *6/15*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply one half by one.
items.demo: The top is four, so the bottom must be *four*. Four over four is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: One times four is four, and two times four is eight: *4/8*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply three fourths by one.
items.demo: The bottom is two, so the top must be *two*. Two over two is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Three times two is six, and four times two is eight: *6/8*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply five sixths by one.
items.demo: The top is five, so the bottom must be *five*. Five over five is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Five times five is twenty-five, and six times five is thirty: *25/30*.

items.prompt: Fill in the blank to multiply four thirds by one.
items.demo: The bottom is six, so the top must be *six*. Six over six is equal to one.

items.prompt: Then, evaluate to write an equivalent fraction.
items.demo: Four times six is twenty-four, and three times six is eighteen: *24/18*.
